briefing: Markets were flat to slightly lower today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.3%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($489.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, and per prior lessons we don't force a buy into a neutral tape just to fill open slots, so we're holding all 7 positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash on the sidelines instead of investing it immediately, so you have capital ready to deploy when a clearly favorable opportunity appears. On a neutral day like today, with cash just below the buy threshold, holding that cash rather than forcing a trade preserves flexibility for a stronger setup later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥」（Dry Powder）指的是保留現金而不急於投資，以便在真正出現理想機會時有資金可以運用。像今日這種中性市況，現金剛好低於買入門檻，寧願持有現金而非勉強交易，可以為日後更佳的入市時機保留靈活性。

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was quiet, with the S&P 500 and NASDAQ both drifting slightly lower in a narrow range. There was no dominant macro catalyst driving the move, consistent with a low-conviction, wait-and-see day for investors. Absent a specific news trigger, the modest pullback looks like routine consolidation rather than the start of a trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平淡，標普500及納指均輕微下跌，波幅有限。市場沒有明顯的宏觀消息主導走勢，反映投資者普遍採取觀望態度。在缺乏具體新聞觸發因素下，這次溫和回調較似是常規整固，而非趨勢逆轉的開端。
